selection_rule: Precommitted P11 public task selection: next four previously unexposed train scenarios in sorted ID order, variant _1; never replace based on outcomes.
server_lease_basis: Identical server command restarted after P10 complete and empty model slot; bounded --max-seconds14400. Per-trial evaluation180sec plus180sec reserve, no start below8100sec remaining.
scope: Same four development scenarios, deterministic recent-history baseline versus recorded P11 full history. One seed; no new method or confirmatory quality claim.
discovery_policy: Initially api_docs and supervisor schemas. A requested app description exposes that public app; individual API documentation exposes that API. New schemas apply on the next model response. No answer-based selection or silent top-k pruning.
interpretation: Same model, public API discovery, action/result grouping, task order, seed and per-trial budgets as P11.
The history budget is a prechosen 4096-token proxy over serialized post-task messages, not the full model context or a hard limit when one whole turn is larger.
No LLM is called for memory selection; tokenizer requests, failures, selection time and boundary capture remain counted.
Do not replace the selected scenarios or tune the window after outcomes. No task or hidden evaluator supplies an oracle target list.
This is a standard recent-memory and archive-read baseline; a successful result would not establish novelty.
Partial-history archive notes are part of this mechanism comparison; no isolated effect of token deletion is claimed.
history_representation: Original standard-role turns remain archived. Full input if history proxy fits4096; otherwise retain newest complete turns until first excess, with at least one turn. Removed spans remain readable. Extra archive metadata is counted in the history proxy and actual input.
